health_check_analysis.discovery: G22 cold-start capture revealed health check was hitting OpenCode, NOT the Python server
health_check_analysis.g21_misinterpretation: G21 assumed port 5233 was the Python server. G22 corrected this.
evidence: Python server not running (ports 4001, 6666 not listening)
Game log shows no mention of port 5233 or health check path
health_check_analysis.conclusion: The health check observed in G21 was OpenCode's own health endpoint, not a Starwing game service

nesys_service_analysis.description: NesysService is the cabinet's service controller for authentication
nesys_service_analysis.certificate_validation: Game requires NesysService for SSL/TLS certificate validation
nesys_service_analysis.error_pattern: NesysControlErrorMessage / id[0] status[4] option[0] -> RequestNetworkInfo -> CertError
nesys_service_analysis.retry_behavior: Game retries ~4575 times over 77 seconds before giving up
nesys_service_analysis.conclusion: NesysService is REQUIRED for game authentication. Without it, game cannot validate certificates.
